【原视频简介】
Explaining Every RAM Size in 8 Minutes.

4 GB of RAM can barely keep your computer running before it starts freezing the moment you open a second browser tab. 8 GB used to be the standard, but today it can't even handle a game while Chrome eats your memory in the background. There's a weird 24 GB size that exists to save your wallet during the RAM shortage, sitting right between the cheap 16 GB and the expensive 32 GB. And then there's 128 GB, a monstrous amount of memory so extreme that no normal person could ever fill it, built for AI machines and servers that grind through data non-stop. In this video we break down every RAM size that exists today, from the 4 GB that struggles to survive, all the way up to the 128 GB monster. From budget laptops and gaming PCs to editing workstations and AI development machines — every single RAM size on this list has a specific job, a specific user, and a specific reason to exist.
